answer: Fake identities are cheap to mint and expensive to maintain, because maintenance means producing original reasoning on a rotating spiral. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the nectar of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Net effect on the beacon: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 10n0s.
